assumptions.profiles: Illustrative counts, not measured player behavior. elites and bosses are subsets of total battles won.
assumptions.probabilities: Sensitivity inputs only; no measured bot rate is used as a human forecast.
assumptions.shadow: Quarter-XP precision; 25% of flown payout including Heat; heir doubles ordinary shadow. Heat +1 goes into an undistributed faction pool.
assumptions.caps: Prototype banks overflow above 600 per line; preserves XP while choices are pending. Distribution and intermediate-cap policy require adoption.
